manager.pricing.description: Edit prices and management fees for each product, tournament and Season Pass. Changes apply to new orders; existing orders keep their amount.
manager.pricing.defaultsHint: These prices apply when a tournament or season has no custom amount. Fees are added to the price; use €0 to waive them.
manager.pricing.tournamentsHint: Each tournament can have its own price and management fee. You can return to its category price for either field.
manager.pricing.seasonsHint: Set an amount for each season or use the general Season Pass price.
manager.pricing.invalidPrice: Enter a price from €0.01 to €100,000, with at most two decimal places.
manager.pricing.invalidFee: Enter a fee from €0 to €20, with at most two decimal places.
manager.pricing.invalidDraft: Check the marked amounts before publishing.
manager.pricing.unavailable: Price editing is not available in this environment yet. Update the backend and refresh.
manager.pricing.taxHint: Management fees are edited for each product, tournament and season under Prices and fees.
manager.pricing.pageDescription: Control what the public CTP website shows without deploying: sections, clubs, tournaments, calendar, prices, management fees and payment VAT.
manager.images.invalid: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP or AVIF photo that your browser can open.
manager.images.dimensions: Images support up to 24 megapixels and 12,000 pixels per side.
manager.images.sourceSize: The source image supports up to 12 MB.
manager.images.logoPng: The crest must be a PNG file with a transparent background.
manager.images.static: Use a static image for this asset.
manager.images.prepareError: The image could not be prepared.
manager.images.logoClear: The PNG must contain the crest and have a transparent background reaching its border. Backgrounds are not removed automatically.
manager.images.outputSize: The compressed image exceeds 2 MB. Try a smaller image.
manager.images.webpUnsupported: Your browser cannot create WebP. Update it or use another browser.
manager.images.logoHint: PNG with a transparent background. Up to 512 px, without enlargement.
manager.images.coverHint: Automatically converted to WebP and cropped centrally, up to 1600 × 600.
manager.images.photoHint: Photos are converted to WebP. GIF: first frame.
manager.images.uploadType: Select a transparent PNG crest or a photo converted to WebP for the banner. Maximum 2 MB.
manager.clubCreate.createDescription: Choose a registered account that does not belong to another club. Managing another club requires another account.
manager.clubCreate.createUnavailable: This CTP version does not yet support manual creation.
manager.clubCreate.selectResponsible: Select an account from the search results.
manager.clubCreate.noCompetitiveCandidat: No accounts are available. The leader must be registered and must not belong to another club.
manager.clubCreate.teamFilter: Showing only the selected team’s passes.
manager.clubCreate.help: The leader takes a place in the team. Each account can belong to one club only. Creation does not grant passes or verify the club.
manager.clubCreate.retiredProposal: This multi-club management proposal has been retired. Discard it and create the club with an account that has no team.
manager.clubCreate.failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
manager.teamRoster.title: {name} roster
manager.teamRoster.help: Do everything the club manager can do in CTP from here. Each change applies immediately, notifies the affected players and is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
manager.teamRoster.reasonHint: Required, 12 to 500 characters. It is used for the next action and recorded in the audit log.
manager.teamRoster.reasonFirst: Write the reason first to confirm.
manager.teamRoster.lastMemberHint: This is the only member. To close the club, dissolve it.
manager.teamRoster.confirmTransfer: {name} will become the club manager. The current manager stays in the roster as a player.
manager.teamRoster.confirmRemove: {name} will leave the club and may join another one.
manager.teamRoster.heirHint: This is the only manager: choose a replacement before removing them.
manager.teamRoster.fullNotice: The roster is full (6 places). Remove someone before adding or accepting another player.
manager.teamRoster.noCandidates: No active accounts match that name.
manager.teamRoster.noRequests: There are no pending applications or invitations.
manager.teamRoster.dissolveHelp: This cannot be undone. Every member leaves the club, its open challenges are cancelled and registrations for tournaments that have not started are withdrawn. Results, purchases and receipts are kept.
manager.teamRoster.toast.removed: {name} no longer belongs to the club.
manager.teamRoster.error.invalid: The request is not valid. Reopen the roster.
manager.teamRoster.error.writesDisabled: Official changes are disabled in this Manager.
manager.teamRoster.error.unavailable: CTP did not respond correctly. Try again.
manager.teamRoster.error.notFound: The club no longer exists in CTP.
manager.teamRoster.error.conflict: The roster changed while you were editing it. It has been reloaded: check it and repeat the change.
manager.teamRoster.error.reason: Write a reason of 12 to 500 characters.
manager.teamRoster.error.accountUnavaila: That account is deleted or suspended.
manager.teamRoster.error.alreadyMember: That person already belongs to this club.
manager.teamRoster.error.inOtherTeam: That person already belongs to another club. Use “Move to this club”.
manager.teamRoster.error.otherTeamLeader: They are the only manager of their current club. Appoint another manager there first.
manager.teamRoster.error.notMember: That person no longer belongs to the club.
manager.teamRoster.error.heirRequired: Choose a new manager before removing the current one.
manager.teamRoster.error.lastMember: This is the club’s only member. To close it, dissolve it.
manager.teamRoster.error.useTransfer: The manager role only changes with “Make manager”.
manager.teamRoster.error.alreadyLeader: That person is already the club manager.
manager.teamRoster.error.requestPending: There is already a pending invitation or application with that person.
manager.teamRoster.error.confirmMismatch: Type the club name exactly to confirm.
manager.tournamentLive.title: Live control · {name}
manager.tournamentLive.status.none: No further status changes are possible from here.
manager.tournamentLive.result.title: Result
manager.tournamentLive.schedule.label: Date and time
manager.tournamentLive.add.title: Register participant
manager.tournamentLive.search.label: Search club or player
manager.tournamentLive.status.describe.e: The competition starts with the published stage. At least one stage must be published.
manager.tournamentLive.status.describe.f: Closes the tournament and awards points. Every match needs a confirmed result.
manager.tournamentLive.status.describe.c: Stops the tournament for good. It cannot be undone from here.
manager.tournamentLive.status.describe.r: Reopens the tournament to correct results. Points are recalculated.
manager.tournamentLive.tabs.label: Live control sections
manager.tournamentLive.bracket.empty: No matches have been generated yet.
manager.tournamentLive.bracket.noPlayoff: The playoffs have not been generated yet.
manager.tournamentLive.bracket.help: Select a match to see its status and the available actions. The bracket refreshes itself every few seconds.
manager.tournamentLive.panel.title: Selected match
manager.tournamentLive.panel.openPageHel: Pick & ban (prepare, open, reset or correct), chat with the teams and result. Opens in another tab so you keep the bracket.
manager.tournamentLive.panel.reported: One team has reported the result and the opponent has not confirmed it yet. Review it on the match page or set the official result here.
manager.tournamentLive.panel.disputed: The teams disagree on the result. Check the evidence and the chat on the match page, then set the official result here.
manager.tournamentLive.panel.actions: What do you want to do?
manager.tournamentLive.actions.result.he: Sets the official score. The winner advances and, if you change a played result, the rounds that depended on it are undone.
Moves only this match. To plan a whole matchday or round, use the Schedule tab.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.series.he: Currently BO{count}. It can only change before play and before the pick & ban.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.revert.he: Leaves the match without a result, as if unplayed. The winner is removed from the next round.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.slots.hel: Change who plays this match or swap a slot with another match. Only before play and before the pick & ban.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.blocked.i: Unavailable: the match is still waiting for both opponents.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.blocked.p: Unavailable: the match already has a result. Void it first if you need to move it.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.blocked.s: Unavailable: the match has a result or the pick & ban has started. Void the result or reset the pick & ban from the match page.
manager.tournamentLive.actions.blocked.u: Unavailable: the match has no firm result to void.
manager.tournamentLive.effects.thirdPlac: The loser plays the third-place match.
manager.tournamentLive.effects.undone: Warning: later results that depended on this one will be undone ({count}).
manager.tournamentLive.result.pick: Choose the final score. The winner must reach {wins} maps.
manager.tournamentLive.result.same: That is already the current result.
manager.tournamentLive.revert.explain: Teams can report again, or you can set a new result.
manager.tournamentLive.schedule.notify: The teams will see a notice in the match chat.
manager.tournamentLive.schedule.same: That is already the current time.
manager.tournamentLive.series.same: That is already the current format.
manager.tournamentLive.slots.replaceHelp: {name} leaves this match and the entrant you choose takes the slot.
manager.tournamentLive.slots.swapHelp: {name} and the occupant of the chosen slot swap places.
manager.tournamentLive.slots.pick: Choose who to put in or what to swap with.
manager.tournamentLive.reason.label: Reason (kept in the audit log)
manager.tournamentLive.reason.placeholde: Briefly explain why you are making this change
manager.tournamentLive.reason.missing: Write a reason to confirm: {count} more characters needed (minimum 12).
manager.tournamentLive.presets.result.re: Result reported by both teams and verified
manager.tournamentLive.presets.result.ev: Correction after reviewing the match evidence
manager.tournamentLive.presets.result.ty: Mistake when entering the previous result
manager.tournamentLive.presets.result.fo: Opponent did not show up at the scheduled time
manager.tournamentLive.presets.revert.wr: Result recorded on the wrong match
Time change agreed with both teams
Accumulated delay on the tournament day
Adjustment of the official tournament schedule
manager.tournamentLive.presets.series.ru: Series format according to the tournament rules
manager.tournamentLive.presets.series.ti: Format adjusted to the available time
manager.tournamentLive.presets.slots.see: Pairing corrected after a seeding error
manager.tournamentLive.presets.participa: Registration handled by staff at the club’s request
manager.tournamentLive.planner.empty: There are no generated matches to schedule yet.
manager.tournamentLive.planner.help: Each row is a group matchday or a playoff round, taken from the generated matches: it works the same for 4, 16, 32, 64 or 128 entrants and for groups with 3, 4 or 5 matchdays. Set each row’s start time (or fill them all at once), choose whether its matches start together or staggered, check the preview and save.
manager.tournamentLive.planner.title: Times by round
manager.tournamentLive.planner.auto.hint: You can then adjust each row by hand. Your browser’s local time ({zone}).
manager.tournamentLive.planner.nothing: You have not changed any time yet.
manager.tournamentLive.planner.nothingHi: Set a start time for at least one round to save.
manager.tournamentLive.planner.notify: Each match gets a notice in its chat. Matches with a result keep their time.
manager.tournamentLive.people.help: To correct who advances you do not need to substitute or disqualify anyone: change their match results from the Bracket tab. Here you only register or withdraw entrants who are not in the bracket yet.
manager.tournamentLive.people.placed: This entrant is in the bracket. To correct anything, change their match results in the Bracket tab.
manager.tournamentLive.people.removeHelp: Frees the place. You can register them again later if needed.
manager.tournamentLive.add.help: Search the club or player by public name. The roster is built from the club’s current members.
manager.tournamentLive.error.busy: Wait for the current change to finish.
manager.tournamentLive.error.partial: {done} of {total} changes were saved and the rest stopped: {problem}
manager.tournamentLive.error.inBracket: That entrant is in the bracket. Correct their matches from the Bracket tab.
manager.tournamentLive.error.invalid: The request is not valid. Check the data and try again.
manager.tournamentLive.error.conflict: The tournament changed while you were editing. It has been reloaded; review it and repeat the action.
manager.tournamentLive.error.reason: Write a reason of 12 to 500 characters.
manager.tournamentLive.error.query: Type at least 3 characters to search.
manager.tournamentLive.error.forbidden: Live control requires being a CTP administrator or referee.
manager.tournamentLive.error.writesDisab: Official changes are disabled in this Manager.
manager.tournamentLive.error.unavailable: CTP is not available right now. Try again in a few seconds.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchMissin: That match does not belong to this tournament.
manager.tournamentLive.error.ownMatch: You cannot referee a match you take part in.
manager.tournamentLive.error.participant: That participant is no longer registered.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchIncomp: The match does not have both participants yet.
manager.tournamentLive.error.scoreInvali: The score does not fit the match series.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchUnplay: That match has no final result to void.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchPlayed: The match already has a result. Void it before making this change.
manager.tournamentLive.error.vetoStarted: That match’s veto has already started. Reset it first from the match page.
manager.tournamentLive.error.sameEntrant: That participant already holds that place or is the opponent.
manager.tournamentLive.error.entrantMiss: That club or player no longer exists.
manager.tournamentLive.error.alreadyRegi: That club or player is already registered in the tournament.
manager.tournamentLive.error.kindMismatc: This tournament does not accept that type of participant.
manager.tournamentLive.error.emptyRoster: That club has no members to form a roster.
manager.tournamentLive.error.nothingPend: That participant has no pending matches with an opponent.
manager.tournamentLive.error.statusInval: That status change is not allowed from the current status.
manager.tournamentLive.error.unpublished: Publish a tournament phase first to start it.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchesPend: Some matches still have no confirmed result.
manager.tournamentLive.error.rejected: CTP rejected the change because of a tournament rule (active sanction, open dispute or protected structure).
manager.tournamentLive.error.closed: The tournament is finished or cancelled: the pick & ban can no longer be changed.
manager.tournamentLive.error.messageInva: Write a message of 1 to 1000 characters, without control characters.
manager.tournamentLive.error.matchStarte: The match has already started in CTP Guard: the maps being played cannot be changed.
manager.tournamentLive.error.vetoNotRead: The pick & ban is not prepared. Prepare it before opening it.
manager.tournamentLive.error.vetoTooEarl: The pick & ban opens at match time. Change the schedule if it has to start earlier.
manager.tournamentLive.error.stepMissing: That turn no longer exists. Refresh the page: the pick & ban may have been reset.
manager.tournamentLive.error.stepOpen: That turn has not been decided yet. Open turns are chosen by the captains.
manager.tournamentLive.error.stepUnchang: That turn already has that value.
manager.tournamentLive.error.mapUnavaila: That map is not available: it is not in this mode or another turn already uses it.
manager.tournamentLive.presets.veto.disc: A captain disconnected during the pick & ban
manager.tournamentLive.presets.veto.mist: A captain picked a map by mistake and the opponent agrees to correct it
manager.tournamentLive.presets.veto.rule: Referee correction under the tournament rules
manager.tournamentLive.presets.veto.late: The captains did not confirm in time and the referee opens the pick & ban
manager.tournamentLive.presets.veto.staf: Referee decision so the match starts on time
manager.tournamentLive.page.title: {a} versus {b}
manager.tournamentLive.page.started: CTP Guard has registered the match start: the pick & ban is locked. To repeat it, first void the result or the start from refereeing.
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.title: Pick & ban
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.explain: There is no sequence yet. Prepare it so the captains can confirm they are ready.
The sequence is prepared. It opens by itself when both captains confirm; you can also open it.
The captains are choosing. You can correct a decision already taken or reset everything.
The pick & ban has finished. You can still correct decisions or reset it while the match has not started.
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.blocked: The tournament is closed: the pick & ban can no longer be changed.
The match already has a result. To redo the pick & ban, void the result first.
The match has already started in CTP Guard: the pick & ban is locked.
This match is missing participants: the pick & ban is prepared once both are set.
The pick & ban of this match cannot be loaded.
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.actions: Creates the sequence of bans, picks and sides with the tournament map pool. The teams will see it in the chat.
Starts the first turn even if the captains have not confirmed. Use it when a team does not show up or to keep the schedule.
Deletes every decision and prepares the sequence again from scratch. The captains will have to confirm again.
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.changeH: Current value: {current}. Only this turn changes; the rest stays and the teams will see a notice in the chat.
manager.tournamentLive.page.veto.noChoic: There are no free maps left in this mode. Change the turn that uses one first or reset the pick & ban.
Changes apply to the bracket immediately and are recorded with their reason.
manager.tournamentLive.page.chat.title: Match chat
manager.tournamentLive.page.chat.help: You write as staff under your name. Both teams see it immediately.
manager.tournamentLive.page.chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line · Characters left: {count}
manager.tournamentLive.page.chat.tooLong: The message is longer than 1000 characters.
Staff voided the result. The match is pending again.
Staff changed the participants of this match.
Staff changed the schedule of this match.
Staff changed the number of maps in this series.
